user.title: Candy simply-Fi washer
user.description: Enter the washer's local IP address (e.g. {example}). The encryption key is recovered automatically from the machine.

reconfigure.title: Change washer address
reconfigure.description: Enter the washer's new local IP address. The encryption key is re-recovered from the machine.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the washer at that address (it does not answer ping; make sure it is powered and on your network).
error.cannot_decrypt: Reached the device but could not decrypt its status — it may not be a Candy simply-Fi module.
